title: How Google is accelerating code migrations with AI
summary: Summarizes Google's paper on an LLM migration pipeline with code indexing and build/test validation, which developers estimate halved migration time.

assertions.quote: Google cut that time in half while having AI generate 70% of the code changes.
Only changes that pass all checks are submitted for review.
Context window constraints, hallucinations, and variable performance across programming languages sometimes require manual intervention.
